document_title: NASA Spaceflight Human-System Standard: Crew Health and Habitability
authority: Office of the Chief Health and Medical Officer (OCHMO), NASA Headquarters

atmospheric_co2_limits.reference: Spacecraft Maximum Allowable Concentrations (SMAC) & NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev C

symptoms_progression.5.0_mmHg: Mild headache in sensitive crew, peripheral vasodilation.
symptoms_progression.7.5_mmHg: Dyspnea on mild exertion, headache, reduced cognitive performance.
symptoms_progression.10.0_mmHg: Severe headache, lethargy, mental confusion, tachycardia.
symptoms_progression.15.0_mmHg: Visual disturbance, hyperventilation, acute hypercapnia risk.
